_prov.source: U.S. Census Bureau, ACS 5-year estimates (tables B01003, B19013), via Census API
_prov.method: Geography: state legislative district (upper chamber) 020, NY; one call per year.
_prov.caveats: District lines were REDRAWN effective 2022: points before and after describe different territory, so the jump at the break is partly a boundary artifact. Each 5-year point overlaps four years with its neighbors. Income in nominal dollars.
